manifest.selection: Twenty-four complete action reports were frozen before tokenizer import or count exposure, balanced twelve per form across matched operational domains. The careful-English controls preserve the proposal's decision-versus-unforeseen-slip semantics rather than merely deleting the marker. Every frozen finite cell will be filed.
manifest.method: Under tiktoken 0.14.0, compute tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english) for every complete pair in cl100k_base, o200k_base and p50k_base. Compute an equal-item mean per tokenizer; the maximum lineage mean is the least-favourable headline. Report per-lineage and per-form diagnostics and the minimum/maximum individual-cell delta. No item selection follows observation.
